verdict.rationale: a-Shell is itself an official, first-party Unix-like command line on iOS. It ships its own commands (`config`, `pickFolder`, `pkg install`, `help -l`), and an off-by-default relay server can accept command lines over HTTPS, so the core of an official CLI is directly delivered. The AI-native part of the story is unevidenced: the CLI only runs inside the iOS app, the relay is meant for trusted networks, the llms.txt probe returned 404, and no agent-oriented or machine-readable output mode is documented. missing for 10: machine-readable/structured output for agents, AI- or agent-specific CLI workflows, a CLI usable outside the iOS app sandbox, versioned CLI reference/changelog, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The goal in this project is to provide a simple Unix-like terminal on iOS.
You install them on your iPad using the `pkg` command: `pkg install zip`.
POST /run takes a UTF-8 command line as its body and requires Content-Length and X-Token
